pages.text: The pack ships graphics profiles by $(bold)hardware$(), applied by the launcher from the PEACOCK_PROFILE setting in Prism:$(br2)$(bold)potato$() iGPU, shaders off · $(bold)low$() iGPU, Complementary at Potato · $(bold)medium$() thin laptops like a MacBook Air · $(bold)high$() laptop with a real GPU · $(bold)ultra$() desktop

Anything you change in the video or shader menus is kept; the profile only sets defaults. Shaders toggle with $(bold)K$(). If frames drop, lower Distant Horizons' radius first, shaders second, render distance last.$(br2)Macs stay on plain Complementary — the Euphoria variant exceeds what macOS OpenGL offers.
